JorMall Company

AI and innovation for smarter business communication.

As JorMall’s technology and product-development arm, the AI and Innovation Division builds intelligent products, automation tools and practical digital solutions that strengthen communication, operations and business growth.

Explore the division See our work
JorMall and our role

Innovation built around JorMall’s business.

JorMall is a Jordanian company specializing in direct marketing, enterprise messaging, customer communication and database solutions. The company helps organizations connect with customers through practical communication services.

Our role inside JorMall

The AI and Innovation Division turns JorMall’s operational knowledge and communication experience into intelligent internal systems, client-facing products and new digital services.

01
Improve how JorMall works We support teams with AI-assisted analysis, automation and better internal tools.
02
Create new services We extend JorMall’s communication expertise into practical AI-powered products for clients.
